# Persistence {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
Persistence()
```
Chart choice for the τ-chart (persistence) by Bandt (2019), Equation (4). For pattern length `m = 3`, the statistic is $\hat{\tau} = \hat{p}_1 + \hat{p}_6 - 1/3$, based on the relative frequencies of the two monotone patterns.
 


:::
